authorization.meaning: Authorize one fresh controlled smoke on the same Ready candidate and continue the release if every hard gate passes.

execution: pull Production environment into an exact temporary file and verify mode, strategy, model, and database availability without publishing secret values
register one synthetic temporary user and run one candidate turn
seal visible and background exact-session evidence before cleanup
delete the temporary user and verify user, session, message, and Trace counts are all zero
promote the exact same candidate deployment
verify the canonical domain resolves to the same deployment and run zero-model canonical route and log checks

requires: one user message and one assistant message
visible response HTTP 200 with no SSE error
visible Trace completed with LLM origin
one visible Provider dispatch and one background Provider dispatch
no retry and no budget overflow
Codex content review pass or minor

onlineVerification.method: same-deployment identity plus canonical domain inspect, zero-model public route checks, and post-promotion logs
onlineVerification.failureAction: promote the retained rollback deployment and verify canonical recovery
